title: Polynomial-time decision with success thresholds
statement: For a function $p\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$, the class $\mathrm{BPP}_{\mathrm{PTM}}(p)$ consists of languages $L$ over the Boolean alphabet for which there are an exponent $e\in\mathbb{N}$, a constant $K\in\mathbb{N}$, and a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine that decides $L$ within time $K(n^e+1)$ with success threshold $p(n)$ on every input of length $n$.
